content.value: Consider disks with an advertised average seek time of 4 ms, rotation speed 12000 rpm and (10) 512 byte sectors with 500 sectors per track. We wish to read a file consisting of 2500 sectors for a total of 1.28 Mbytes. Find total average access time for: i) sequential access and ii) random access.
